b1-unit-28.28.1 Checking in and checking out:
Receptionist: Good afternoon, and welcome to the Tango Garden Hotel. How can I help you?
Danny: Hi! I have a reservation for three nights. It's under my first name, Danny. I booked online.
Receptionist: Let me check... Yes, a single room with an en-suite bathroom, for three nights. Could you fill in this form, please? And I'll need your passport.
Danny: Sure, here you are. Would you mind telling me what time breakfast is served?
Receptionist: Not at all. Breakfast is from seven to ten thirty, and it's complimentary.
Danny: Great! I've just come back from two weeks in Patagonia, and all my clothes are filthy. Is there a laundry service?
Receptionist: Yes, there is. You'll find a bag and a price list in your room. If you give it to the housekeeper before ten, it'll be ready the same day.
Danny: Perfect. Do you mind if I leave my backpack here for an hour? I'd like to get something to eat first.
Receptionist: Of course not. I'll put it in the storeroom. And here's your key card. Room three-oh-four, on the third floor. The elevator is just over there.
Narrator: Three days later.
Danny: Good morning! I'd like to check out, please. Room three-oh-four.
Receptionist: Certainly. Here's your bill.
Danny: Thanks. Could you tell me what this charge is for?
Receptionist: Let me see... That's for two drinks from the minibar.
Danny: I'm sorry, but I didn't have anything from the minibar. I didn't even open it.
Receptionist: Oh, I do apologize. Let me check with the housekeeper... You're right, it was a mistake. I've taken it off the bill.
Danny: Thank you. Can I pay by card?
Receptionist: Yes, of course.
Danny: One more thing. My bus doesn't leave until six. Would it be possible to leave my bags here until then?
Receptionist: Certainly. And would you mind writing us a review? It really helps.
Danny: Not at all. I'll write one on the bus!
b1-unit-28.28.2 Repeat: polite requests:
Narrator: Could you tell me what this charge is for?
Narrator: Would you mind telling me what time breakfast is served?
Narrator: Do you mind if I leave my backpack here?
Narrator: Would it be possible to leave my bags here until six?
Narrator: Could I have a towel, please?
Narrator: I was wondering if I could check in early.
